name: Campingplatz Ammertal
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Ammertal is situated on the outskirts of Peißenberg in the alpine foothills. Nestled in a quiet valley close to the River Ammer, the park features pitches for motorhomes and tents, complemented by clean sanitary amenities and a children's playground. The picturesque surroundings offer attractive hiking and cycle trails, while the historic market town of Peißenberg with its local shops is within easy walking distance.
